name: Unfrozen Deliveries

faq.answer: A thief ransacked the outgoing mail just days ago, likely searching for coin, before fleeing into the northern hills.
The thief ran into the hills north of Everlook, where yetis prowl the snowy slopes.
faq.q: Where was the missing mail taken?

aliases: who takes the mail in everlook
faq.answer: Innkeeper Vizzie in Everlook needs the missing letters recovered before any return mail can depart for Mount Hyjal.
faq.q: Who wants the missing mail returned?

aliases: why is the mail going to hyjal
where does the return mail go
faq.answer: The recovered letters are return mail meant to be carried to Mount Hyjal once gathered.
faq.q: Where is the mail meant to go?

faq.answer: The thief never returned from the hills, and Innkeeper Vizzie suspects yetis tore the robber apart.
faq.q: What happened to the thief in the hills?

sections.body: Innkeeper Vizzie has run into trouble with the return mail bound for Mount Hyjal. A few days ago, a thief rifled through the outgoing post in search of coin and fled into the hills north of Everlook. The letters lie scattered across the snowy slopes where yetis prowl. Until those lost parcels are gathered from the wilds, no deliveries will reach the mountain.
sections.title: Scattered in the Snow

summary: Innkeeper Vizzie needs the return mail destined for Mount Hyjal, but a thief ransacked the post and fled north of Everlook. With the bandit likely slain by yetis, the missing letters lie scattered in the cold hills.
